findings.highlight: We’ve skipped breakfast
findings.evidenceJa: 朝飯を抜いていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou had skipped breakfast
findings.explanation: A singular fact about Shirou becomes a shared action by Shirou and Saber.

findings.highlight: I’m not sending her magical energy like all the other Masters are doing
findings.evidenceJa: 本来マスターから得られる筈の魔力提供もない
findings.governingReading: she lacks the magical-energy provision she should normally receive from her Master
findings.explanation: A rule-bound expected provision becomes an unsupported contemporaneous comparison with every other Master.

findings.highlight: doing so doesn’t replenish it
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の補充は万全とはいかない
findings.governingReading: replenishment of magical energy will not be complete
findings.explanation: Partial or imperfect replenishment is changed into none at all.

findings.highlight: I ask her after cleaning up our meal
findings.evidenceJa: エプロンをたたみながら質問する
findings.governingReading: he asks while folding his apron after putting away the dishes
findings.explanation: Shirou’s precise domestic action disappears.

findings.highlight: Magical energy is constantly created within oneself
findings.evidenceJa: 活動している内は絶え間なく生成される
findings.governingReading: magical energy is generated continuously while one is active
findings.explanation: The condition tying generation to ongoing activity disappears.

findings.highlight: A Servant without any outside source
findings.evidenceJa: 自然からの供給がないサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: a Servant without a supply from nature
findings.explanation: A specific natural source of magical energy is generalized.

findings.highlight: can create magical energy using its own Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 自身の魔術回路だけで少なからず魔力を補充する
findings.governingReading: can replenish no small amount of magical energy through its own circuits alone
findings.explanation: Replenishing reserves by internal circuits becomes generic creation and loses the nontrivial degree.

findings.highlight: there will be more dripping water the more water the cup holds
findings.evidenceJa: グラスが重ければ重いほど蛇口の栓が開かれていく
findings.governingReading: the heavier the glass becomes, the farther the faucet valve opens
findings.explanation: The analogy’s weight-to-valve mechanism is replaced by a looser quantity correlation.

findings.highlight: elimination for the Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントにとっての消滅
findings.governingReading: a Servant’s disappearance from existence
findings.explanation: A Fate-specific existential state becomes tournament-like elimination.

findings.highlight: receive a fatal wound
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体を維持できぬほどの傷を負う
findings.governingReading: suffer an injury so severe the body can no longer be maintained
findings.explanation: A failure of manifested-body maintenance is collapsed into ordinary fatality.

findings.highlight: to lose enough magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 自身を保つほどの魔力を維持できなくなる
findings.governingReading: become unable to maintain enough magical energy to preserve oneself
findings.explanation: The threshold and self-maintenance relation are lost in an incomplete phrase.

findings.highlight: the faucet will create more water and fill the cup up
findings.evidenceJa: 時間が経てばまたグラスに水は溜まる
findings.governingReading: with time, water will accumulate in the glass again
findings.explanation: The necessary passage of time and restoration of a prior state disappear.

findings.highlight: I could empty out the whole cup
findings.evidenceJa: 一瞬で空になる危険もある
findings.governingReading: there is a risk the full glass will become empty in an instant
findings.explanation: A dangerous instantaneous depletion is weakened into bare possibility.

findings.highlight: as I, her faucet, am not giving her magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 俺という蛇口を封じられているセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber has the faucet that is Shirou sealed shut
findings.explanation: Shirou’s defective blocked channel becomes a voluntary-looking failure to give energy.

findings.highlight: sleep right after that
findings.evidenceJa: 長時間の睡眠をとって
findings.governingReading: sleep for a long period afterward
findings.explanation: The required recovery duration disappears and is replaced by immediacy.

findings.highlight: stop consuming any unnecessary magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: グラスに水滴を溜めなくてはいけない
findings.governingReading: must accumulate droplets in the glass
findings.explanation: The positive goal of rebuilding reserves disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t know how I’ll apologize to you if it causes you to die
findings.evidenceJa: そんなんで死なれたりしたら、どう謝っていいか分からない
findings.governingReading: if she died from that, he would not know how he could ever make amends
findings.explanation: The English proposes apologizing directly to Saber after her death, creating a logical absurdity.

findings.highlight: I place the tea in front of Saber
findings.evidenceJa: とん、とセイバーの前に食後のお茶を置く
findings.governingReading: he sets the after-meal tea before Saber with a light thump
findings.explanation: The emphatic physical punctuation of Shirou’s prohibition disappears.

findings.highlight: The phone rings
findings.evidenceJa: タイミングよく電話のベルが鳴り響いた
findings.governingReading: the telephone bell rings at just the right moment
findings.explanation: The comic timing and resonant bell disappear.

findings.highlight: She simply discards all the chaotic events
findings.evidenceJa: この人の一声でぐるんと日常にひっくり返る
findings.governingReading: at one word from her, the world flips sharply back into everyday life
findings.explanation: Taiga’s voice transforming Shirou’s felt world becomes her deliberate dismissal of events.

findings.highlight: to teach my students
findings.evidenceJa: 教え子の面倒みてる
findings.governingReading: looking after her pupils
findings.explanation: Taiga’s broader caretaking role is narrowed to instruction.

findings.highlight: There are no robbers or fires here
findings.evidenceJa: 火事も泥棒もサーカスも来てない
findings.governingReading: neither fire, burglar, nor circus has come here
findings.explanation: The escalating absurdity of Shirou’s three-part comic list loses its circus.

findings.highlight: I try to cut off our conversation
findings.evidenceJa: 手短に会話を切る
findings.governingReading: he curtly ends the conversation
findings.explanation: A completed conversational action becomes an unsuccessful or uncertain attempt.

findings.highlight: I’m calling you
findings.evidenceJa: 恥をしのいでお姉ちゃんが電話してる
findings.governingReading: his big sister has swallowed her pride to call him
findings.explanation: Taiga’s performed sister role and claimed humiliation disappear.

findings.highlight: I guess she’s in a little trouble right now too
findings.evidenceJa: 恥を忍ばず凌いでいるあたり、藤ねえ的にライブで小ピンチ
findings.governingReading: her failure to swallow shame suggests Fuji-nee is live in a minor crisis
findings.explanation: The narration’s wordplay on 忍ぶ／凌ぐ and “live” comic framing disappear.

findings.highlight: that sweet omelet
findings.evidenceJa: 甘々の卵焼き
findings.governingReading: his very sweet rolled omelet
findings.explanation: The childish repeated intensifier and specific dish are generalized.

findings.highlight: I want it delivered to the archery range right away
findings.evidenceJa: 至急弓道部まで届けられたし
findings.governingReading: see that it is delivered to the archery club at once
findings.explanation: Taiga’s mock-imperious formal command becomes a statement of desire.

findings.highlight: the omelet will be easy to make
findings.evidenceJa: 卵焼きぐらいならササッと追加できる
findings.governingReading: he can quickly add a rolled omelet
findings.explanation: The speed and addition to existing leftovers disappear.

findings.highlight: there could be exceptions
findings.evidenceJa: 万が一という事もある
findings.governingReading: there is always the one-in-ten-thousand contingency
findings.explanation: A low-probability danger becomes generic exceptions to a rule.

findings.highlight: take a huge breath
findings.evidenceJa: 空気を吸う
findings.governingReading: draws in air to calm himself
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds unsupported magnitude to Shirou’s breath.

findings.highlight: Saber looks up at me
findings.evidenceJa: むっ、と見上げてくるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber looks up at him with offended displeasure
findings.explanation: Saber’s displeased challenge disappears.

findings.highlight: She’s putting pressure on me, but I stare back at her
findings.evidenceJa: じりじりと気圧されながら、それでも必死にセイバーを見つめ返す
findings.governingReading: though steadily overawed, he desperately holds Saber’s gaze
findings.explanation: The gradual effect on Shirou and his desperation are flattened.

findings.highlight: I’m telling you to just do so
findings.evidenceJa: 大人しくしてろって言ってるんだ
findings.governingReading: he is telling her to stay put and behave
findings.explanation: A concrete order becomes malformed English with no usable referent.

findings.highlight: I cannot obey
findings.evidenceJa: 私も引き下がれない
findings.governingReading: she cannot back down either
findings.explanation: Saber’s own refusal to yield becomes inability to obey.

findings.highlight: Man, this is pathetic, but I’m running away. And I’m doing it in front of my opponent, too!
findings.evidenceJa: ああそう、みっともないけど逃亡だ。しかも敵前、弁解の余地まるでなし！
findings.governingReading: the Japanese self-reproach line is inactive because it is prefixed with a semicolon
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates a superseded line in which Shirou calls his flight shameful and inexcusable before the enemy.

findings.highlight: I run outside and slap my blushing face
findings.evidenceJa: 顔をバシバシ叩きながら、だあーっと外まで駆け抜けた
findings.governingReading: he repeatedly slaps his flushed face while dashing all the way outside
findings.explanation: Simultaneous frantic movement, repetition, and force are flattened.

findings.highlight: I’ll apologize for yelling at her
findings.evidenceJa: 謝るなりして許して貰おう
findings.governingReading: he will apologize and get her to forgive him
findings.explanation: The desired relational outcome of obtaining Saber’s forgiveness disappears.

findings.highlight: After glaring at me
findings.evidenceJa: いかにも何か言いたげにこっちを睨んだ
findings.governingReading: she glares as though plainly wanting to say something
findings.explanation: Saber’s visibly withheld speech disappears.

findings.highlight: it must mean the Servant did not hear
findings.evidenceJa: おそらく聞こえなかったのでしょう
findings.governingReading: the Servant probably failed to hear
findings.explanation: Saber’s dry probable fiction becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: She turns away from me
findings.evidenceJa: ぷい、と不機嫌そうに顔を背けてしまった
findings.governingReading: she petulantly turns her face away in evident displeasure
findings.explanation: Saber’s sulking physical delivery disappears.

findings.highlight: silently putting pressure on me
findings.evidenceJa: 無言でプレッシャーを投げ続ける
findings.governingReading: keeps hurling silent pressure at him
findings.explanation: The repeated, projectile-like force of Saber’s protest is flattened.

findings.highlight: I glare at the girl
findings.evidenceJa: 相手を睨み付ける
findings.governingReading: he glares at his opponent
findings.explanation: The conflictual relational label is replaced with a generic gender label.

findings.highlight: I ignore Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 今度こそ本当に、セイバーを無視して
findings.governingReading: this time he truly ignores Saber
findings.explanation: The recurrence and escalation after earlier failed attempts disappear.

findings.highlight: that’s good
findings.evidenceJa: ついてるって言えばついてる
findings.governingReading: it is lucky, if one chooses to call it luck
findings.explanation: Shirou’s qualified evaluation of his fortune becomes generic approval.

findings.highlight: I still shouldn’t go any further
findings.evidenceJa: ここから先は無理だ
findings.governingReading: from here onward, allowing Saber to follow is impossible
findings.explanation: The limit imposed on Saber is reassigned to Shirou’s own movement.

findings.highlight: I give up
findings.evidenceJa: 根負けした
findings.governingReading: he gives in after being outlasted
findings.explanation: Saber’s persistence defeating Shirou’s resistance is generalized.

findings.highlight: comes up to me
findings.evidenceJa: とつとつと上がってきた
findings.governingReading: comes steadily up the slope in measured steps
findings.explanation: Saber’s peculiar, deliberate approach disappears.

findings.highlight: I cannot allow my Master to be in danger
findings.evidenceJa: みすみすマスターを危険にさらす訳にはいきません
findings.governingReading: she cannot knowingly stand by and expose her Master to danger
findings.explanation: Saber’s refusal to permit an avoidable danger is weakened to generic protection.

findings.highlight: consider that as my magical energy being created
findings.evidenceJa: それが私自身の魔力生成量だと思ってください
findings.governingReading: regard that as the amount of magical energy she generates
findings.explanation: A quantitative rate in the faucet analogy becomes the generic process of energy creation.

findings.highlight: The rate being just that of dripping water.
findings.evidenceJa: なにしろ零れ落ちる水滴程度の回復量なんだから
findings.governingReading: her recovery rate is only that of falling droplets
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves a dependent participial fragment as a standalone sentence.

findings.highlight: scared by the consequences of ignoring the call
findings.evidenceJa: どんな逆襲が待っているか恐ろしい
findings.governingReading: he fears what kind of counterattack awaits if he pretends not to be home
findings.explanation: Taiga’s comic retaliatory threat is generalized into unspecified consequences.

findings.highlight: I’ll only be gone for a while
findings.evidenceJa: すぐに戻ってくるから、待っててくれ
findings.governingReading: he will return immediately, so he asks Saber to wait
findings.explanation: The direct request to wait and the promise of an immediate return disappear.

findings.highlight: Bye
findings.evidenceJa: カチリ
findings.governingReading: the receiver clicks as Taiga hangs up
findings.explanation: A mechanical hang-up sound becomes unsupported spoken dialogue.

findings.highlight: When I look next to me
findings.evidenceJa: 気を取り直して隣を見る
findings.governingReading: regaining his composure, he looks beside him
findings.explanation: Shirou’s attempt to reset himself before discovering Saber’s action disappears.

findings.highlight: I’ll tell her now
findings.evidenceJa: ここで言い含めておこう
findings.governingReading: he will carefully impress the point on her here
findings.explanation: Shirou’s intention to make Saber understand and accept a rule becomes generic telling.

findings.highlight: That is the time that requires the most attention
findings.evidenceJa: 睡眠中など最も警護すべき対象です
findings.governingReading: while sleeping, Shirou is precisely the person most requiring protection
findings.explanation: The object of protection and explicit guarding duty disappear.

findings.highlight: This town has lots of hills
findings.evidenceJa: 深山町は坂の多い町
findings.governingReading: Miyama Town is a town of many hills
findings.explanation: A named Fuyuki district is reduced to an anonymous town.

findings.highlight: She looks even more angry
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの不機嫌さには磨きがかかっている
findings.governingReading: Saber’s displeasure has been polished to an even finer edge
findings.explanation: The comic metaphor for her increasingly perfected sulk becomes generic anger.

findings.highlight: Well, let’s make up a story for you. You’re a relative of my father, and you came here to visit and sightsee. Is that all right?
findings.evidenceJa: ほら、そうと決まったら口裏を合わせよう。セイバーは親父の親戚で、観光がてらに遊びにきたってコトでいいか？
findings.governingReading: Now that it is decided, let us get our stories straight: Saber is my father's relative who came to visit while sightseeing.
findings.explanation: 口裏を合わせる describes mutually coordinating a cover story, while “make up a story for you” makes Shirou the sole inventor and Saber the object of the story. The shared deception/coordination is weakened.

findings.highlight: I’m not surprised by Tohsaka’s kindness, but just that she’d have such feminine clothes.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の手際の良さ、というより、このお嬢様っぽい洋服が遠坂の持ち物だってコトがびっくりだ。
findings.governingReading: Rather than Tohsaka's efficiency in handling things, what surprises Shirou is that these lady-like clothes are Tohsaka's belongings.
findings.explanation: 手際の良さ means competence or deftness, not kindness. The English changes Shirou's surprise at Rin's practical capability and ownership of the clothes into surprise at her generosity.

findings.highlight: That armor is formed from my magical energy. I can remove it at will.
findings.evidenceJa: あの鎧は私の魔力で編まれたものです。解除する、という事は消すという事。
findings.governingReading: The armor is woven from my magical energy; deactivating it means making it disappear.
findings.explanation: The English introduces an at-will removal ability and omits the source's explicit explanation that解除 is disappearance. The construction/dismissal mechanic is flattened into ordinary removal.

findings.highlight: So you can take it out at will?
findings.evidenceJa: あの武装はいつでも出したり消したり出来るって事か
findings.governingReading: So that armament can be brought out and made to disappear whenever you want?
findings.explanation: The English retains only producing/taking out the armor and drops the paired ability to dismiss it. The source explicitly describes a reversible summon/disappear toggle.

findings.highlight: Saber does not answer me and continues up the hill.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは俺の失言には何も答えず、とつとつと坂道を上っていった。
findings.governingReading: Without answering my indiscreet remark, Saber plods or proceeds haltingly up the hill.
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou's recognition that he made a verbal blunder and omits the halting/plodding manner in which Saber continues uphill. It turns a socially awkward silence into a generic non-answer.

findings.highlight: Oh well. I guess I’ll just pretend I’m showing a new student around school.
findings.evidenceJa: ここまできたら開き直るしかない。転入生を案内する、と思えばなんとかなる。
findings.governingReading: Having come this far, I can only brazen it out; if I think of it as showing a transfer student around, it should somehow work.
findings.explanation: 開き直る is a deliberate decision to stop worrying and face the situation boldly, while “Oh well” is passive resignation. “Pretend” also makes it conscious deception rather than Shirou's mental reframing, and the hopeful なんとかなる disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber? What’s with that severe expression? Don’t scare me like that.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバー？　なんだよ、怖い顔して。脅かしっこはなしだぞ
findings.governingReading: Saber? What is it with that scary face? No scaring each other, okay?
findings.explanation: 脅かしっこ is a reciprocal, playful “no trying to scare each other” formulation. “Don’t scare me like that” makes it a one-sided accusation and loses Shirou's attempt to defuse the tension jokingly.

findings.highlight: This is a place where a great magus has gone for over a year.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女ほどの魔術師が一年以上居る場所なのです。
findings.governingReading: This is a place where a magus of her caliber has been/stayed for more than a year.
findings.explanation: 居る describes continued presence, while “has gone for over a year” uses the wrong motion and tense, suggesting an act of going rather than Rin's long-term presence at the school.

findings.highlight: It seems the magical energy Saber feels is from Tohsaka.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが感じとった魔力とやらは、どうも遠坂の残り香らしい。
findings.governingReading: The so-called magical energy Saber sensed seems to be the lingering trace or scent left by Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: 残り香 gives a figurative image of a lingering residue after Rin has gone, while the English makes the energy simply originate from Tohsaka. とやら's skeptical distance also disappears.

findings.highlight: She’s pretty stupid for getting her magical energy sensed
findings.evidenceJa: あいつも結構ドジなんだな。
findings.governingReading: She is pretty clumsy/careless too.
findings.explanation: ドジ is clumsy or careless, not stupid. The English changes Shirou's teasing assessment of Rin's mistake into a judgment about her intelligence.

findings.highlight: for getting her magical energy sensed even before you went inside.
findings.evidenceJa: 入る前からセイバーに魔力感知されるなんて。
findings.governingReading: To have her magical energy detected by Saber before entering [the school/grounds].
findings.explanation: The English addresses Saber as the person who went inside (“you”) and uses past tense, while the Japanese is an implicit-entry reference in Shirou's narration/remark. It introduces an unclear or wrong actor for the entrance.

findings.highlight: I told you there’s no danger here. All right, let’s go in.
findings.evidenceJa: だから危険なんてないって言っただろ。ほら、中に入るからちゃんと付いてこいよ
findings.governingReading: I told you there is no danger. Come on, we are going inside, so make sure you follow me properly.
findings.explanation: ちゃんと付いてこいよ is an explicit instruction for Saber to stay with Shirou. The English drops the follow/stay-together action and leaves only a generic invitation to enter.

findings.highlight: “I’m here to deliver her lunch as you guessed. Is Fuji-nee here?”
findings.evidenceJa: 「お疲れ。お察しの通り飯を届けに来た。藤ねえは中に居るか？」
findings.governingReading: Good work/hello. As you guessed, I came to deliver lunch. Is Fuji-nee inside?
findings.explanation: お疲れ is a routine social greeting and is omitted entirely, making Shirou's familiar exchange with Ayako more abrupt and less socially grounded.

findings.highlight: We were worried because she was hungry and started getting edgy.
findings.evidenceJa: 藤村先生ったら空腹でテンション高くて困ってたのよ。
findings.governingReading: Fujimura-sensei was so high-energy from hunger that she was causing us trouble.
findings.explanation: テンション高くて困ってた describes comic hyperactivity that inconveniences the club, while “worried” and “edgy” recast it as concern and nervousness.

findings.highlight: We’re short on money already, so I can’t be spending money on emergency food.
findings.evidenceJa: ただでさえ備品で金食ってるんだから、非常食に金はさけないでしょ
findings.governingReading: Equipment already eats up money, so we cannot spare money for emergency food.
findings.explanation: The English removes the specific source of the club's financial pressure—equipment—leaving only generic shortage of money.

findings.highlight: In the archery club, anyone resting their arm and taking a break is sent on a grocery run as an exercise.
findings.evidenceJa: 弓道部では、腕の筋肉を休めている暇人が走り込みと称して買い出しに行かされる。
findings.governingReading: In the archery club, idle people resting their arm muscles are sent on a shopping trip under the pretense/name of running training.
findings.explanation: The source's joke is that shopping is falsely called running training; the English says the grocery run itself is an exercise. 暇人 (idle person) is also reduced to anyone taking a break.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what she’s happy about, but she smiles.
findings.evidenceJa: 何が嬉しいのか、にんまりと笑う美綴。
findings.governingReading: Mitsuzuri grins broadly/smugly, apparently pleased by something.
findings.explanation: にんまり is a distinct pleased, knowing grin; the English reduces it to a neutral smile and makes Shirou's observation less teasing.

findings.highlight: “Hey, just take the bag. Isn’t it a problem in there with Fuji-nee going wild?”
findings.evidenceJa: おい。嫌味はいいから受け取れ。中、藤ねえが暴れててタイヘンなんじゃないのか
findings.governingReading: Hey, enough with the sarcasm; take it. Isn't it a real mess inside with Fuji-nee running wild?
findings.explanation: 嫌味 is Shirou's direct response to Ayako's teasing/snide remark and is omitted; the English adds “bag” but loses the banter that motivates his command.

findings.highlight: First of all, you should know she’d get mad if I turned you away here.
findings.evidenceJa: 入り口でアンタを帰したなんて言ったらもっとへそ曲げるに決まってるじゃない。
findings.governingReading: If I told her I sent you home at the entrance, she would definitely sulk/become even more contrary.
findings.explanation: へそ曲げる is sulking or becoming stubborn, not generic anger. The English loses Taiga's childish, comic reaction and makes her sound simply mad.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to be chewed out by Fujimura-sensei, so
findings.evidenceJa: あたしは藤村先生にしごかれたくはないからね。
findings.governingReading: I don't want Fujimura-sensei to put me through her harsh training/discipline.
findings.explanation: しごかれる means being put through the wringer or subjected to harsh training/handling, not merely being verbally reprimanded. “Chewed out” changes the nature of Taiga's threat to Ayako.

findings.highlight: so go on in.
findings.evidenceJa: ほら、ここまで来たら観念して中に入りな
findings.governingReading: Now that you have come this far, resign yourself and go inside.
findings.explanation: The English drops the “you have come this far, so accept your fate” logic and turns Ayako's playful coercion into a plain direction.

findings.highlight: It’s bad if the teacher starts looking at her students’ lunches.
findings.evidenceJa: 顧問が生徒の昼飯を物欲しそうに見て回る、なんてイメージ悪すぎるぞ
findings.governingReading: It gives a terrible impression for the club advisor to go around looking at students' lunches with a covetous expression.
findings.explanation: 物欲しそうに (looking hungry/covetous) and the extreme イメージ悪すぎ are reduced to neutral looking and “bad.” The joke about a teacher eyeing students' food disappears.

findings.highlight: Then, she suddenly comes up to me and whispers into my ear.
findings.evidenceJa: と、唐突に体を寄せると、内緒話でもするかのように耳元に近づいて、
findings.governingReading: She suddenly draws close, bringing herself near my ear as though she were going to tell a secret.
findings.explanation: The source uses an as-if comparison; the English asserts that Ayako actually whispers. It also compresses the deliberate approach-to-the-ear staging into a generic coming up and whispering.

findings.highlight: All the more if she’s coming into the archery range after me.
findings.evidenceJa: それが無言で、俺の後について弓道場に入ろうとしているんだから尚更だ。
findings.governingReading: All the more because she is silently trying to enter the archery range after me.
findings.explanation: 無言で is omitted, and 入ろうとしている (is attempting to enter) becomes the more definite “is coming into.” The unusual silent following that makes Saber conspicuous is weakened.

findings.highlight: I’m curious, but I like that condition. Don’t take it back later, okay, Emiya?
findings.evidenceJa: 事情は気になるけど、その交換条件は気に入った。衛宮、あとでチャラってのはなしだからね
findings.governingReading: I am curious about the circumstances, but I like that exchange condition. Emiya, don't try to call us even later.
findings.explanation: あとでチャラ is a debt/quid-pro-quo joke (“don't say we're even later”), not taking back a promise or condition. The English changes Ayako's bargaining wit and the implied favor Shirou owes her.

findings.highlight: I’m going to practice, so can you move the stove?
findings.evidenceJa: 巻藁練習するんでストーブ移動させてくださーい！
findings.governingReading: We are going to practice makiwara (straw-target shooting), so please move the stove.
findings.explanation: 巻藁 is a specific archery practice target and is omitted, leaving only generic “practice.” The concrete reason the stove must be moved disappears.

findings.highlight: “That’s just her side hurting! I ate it and I’m doing fine, so just give her some kelp tea!”
findings.evidenceJa: そんなのただの腹痛よ！一緒に食べた先生は元気なんだから、岬さんには昆布茶でも飲ませておきなさい！
findings.governingReading: That's just a stomachache! The teacher who ate it with her is fine, so give Misaki some kelp tea.
findings.explanation: 腹痛 is a stomachache, not pain in the side. The English changes the reported ailment and omits Misaki's name, replacing Taiga's brisk medical dismissal with an unclear “side hurting.”

findings.highlight: Geez, why is this bow like this?
findings.evidenceJa: なんだってこんなに裏反ってんのよこの弓ってば。
findings.governingReading: Why is this bow bent/warped backward like this?
findings.explanation: 裏反って specifies the bow's abnormal backward curve, while “like this” removes the physical defect being discussed.

findings.highlight: If you break it, your neck will be broken later on.
findings.evidenceJa: ひっくり返して切詰めが離れたら、あとで首を折っちゃうんだから。
findings.governingReading: If you turn it over and the cut/limb joint comes loose, you could break your neck later.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the specific bow failure condition 切詰めが離れる with “if you break it,” making the student the cause of breaking the bow and erasing the mechanical chain that leads to injury.

findings.highlight: “Sensei! We don’t have any powder! My hand’s slipping!”
findings.evidenceJa: 先生っー！　ぎり粉がありませーん！　手が、手が滑りますー！
findings.governingReading: Sensei! There is no giriko/bowstring powder! My hands are slipping!
findings.explanation: ぎり粉 is a specific archery grip/stringing aid, but the English reduces it to generic powder. The plural/repeated hand panic is also flattened to one hand.

findings.highlight: Sakura puts down the bow in her hand and runs to me.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は手にした弓を置いて、目を白黒させて駆け寄ってきた。
findings.governingReading: Sakura puts down the bow she is holding and rushes over, visibly flustered/stunned.
findings.explanation: 目を白黒させて conveys shocked confusion or flustered bewilderment; the English removes that reaction and makes her approach neutral running.

findings.highlight: Oh, was I too late? I made some for you as well, but was it unnecessary?
findings.evidenceJa: なんだ、もしかしてホントに手遅れか？　いちおう桜の分も作っといたのも、無駄？
findings.governingReading: What, is it perhaps really too late? Was the portion I made for Sakura just in case a waste too?
findings.explanation: 手遅れ refers to Taiga's situation being too late to remedy, while “was I too late?” makes Shirou's arrival timing the problem. いちおう (just in case/for good measure) is also omitted.

findings.highlight: I don’t think anyone’s going to complain if that’s the case.
findings.evidenceJa: みんなもそういう事情なら昼食を再開しても文句ないだろうけどな
findings.governingReading: If that is the situation, everyone probably won't object to resuming lunch.
findings.explanation: The English omits the concrete action 昼食を再開する (resume lunch), leaving only a generic lack of complaints. The social consequence of Sakura eating and the club restarting its meal is lost.

findings.highlight: Yeah. Since I’m here, I’ll stay here until the club is over. I skipped making dinner yesterday, so I’ll cook dinner today. Come and eat with us.
findings.evidenceJa: そうだな、せっかく来たんだし、部活が終わるまで学校にいるよ。昨日はすっぽかしたし、今日の夕飯は俺が作るから、桜も食べに来てくれ
findings.governingReading: Since I made the effort to come, I'll stay until club ends; I blew off dinner yesterday, so I'll cook tonight—Sakura, you come eat too.
findings.explanation: せっかく来た emphasizes the effort of coming and 桜も explicitly invites Sakura too. “Since I’m here” is flatter and “with us” adds an unspecified group in place of the direct invitation.

findings.highlight: When I look around, Mitsuzuri is explaining things to the students that are getting rowdy from seeing Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: 振り返れば、セイバーを見てざわつき始めた部員たちに説明して回る美綴がいた。
findings.governingReading: When I look back, Mitsuzuri is going around explaining things to the club members who have begun to stir at the sight of Saber.
findings.explanation: 部員たち becomes generic students, ざわつく (murmur/stir) becomes stronger “getting rowdy,” and 説明して回る (going around explaining) is reduced to a static explanation. The social staging is exaggerated and flattened.

findings.highlight: I’ve accomplished my goal
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず、これで当初の目的は果たせた
findings.governingReading: for the moment, he has accomplished his original purpose
findings.explanation: A provisional checkpoint and the distinction between the original purpose and broader aims disappear.

findings.highlight: as she drinks some tea
findings.evidenceJa: ずずー、とお茶を飲みながら
findings.governingReading: while noisily slurping her tea
findings.explanation: Taiga’s comic audible manner of drinking disappears.

findings.highlight: the sound of arrows
findings.evidenceJa: 弦と矢の風切り音
findings.governingReading: the wind-cutting sounds of bowstrings and arrows
findings.explanation: The bowstrings and the specific cutting-through-air quality are omitted from the dojo soundscape.

findings.highlight: The club’s over at five
findings.evidenceJa: 部活は五時に終わらせる
findings.governingReading: I’ll bring club practice to an end at five
findings.explanation: Taiga’s authority and decision to end practice become an impersonal schedule fact.

findings.highlight: Saber is looking at the archery range with interest
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはセイバーで弓道場の様子を興味深そうに眺めている
findings.governingReading: Saber, for her part, is watching the state of the archery hall with interest
findings.explanation: The parallel “Saber in her own way” framing and her interest in the activity as a whole are weakened.

findings.highlight: munching on some sweet bean jelly
findings.evidenceJa: 羊羹をついばむ
findings.governingReading: nibbles or pecks at the yōkan
findings.explanation: Taiga’s small, birdlike comic eating gesture becomes heavier generic munching.

findings.highlight: It must be because Fuji-nee is calm now
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえが大人しくなった為か
findings.governingReading: perhaps because Fuji-nee has quieted down
findings.explanation: The narrator’s tentative inference is promoted to certainty.

findings.highlight: Mitsuzuri-san
findings.evidenceJa: 控えにいる美綴さん
findings.governingReading: Mitsuzuri, who is waiting in reserve
findings.explanation: Mitsuzuri’s current position or waiting status disappears from the request.

findings.highlight: Please stay at your leisure
findings.evidenceJa: ゆっくりしていってください
findings.governingReading: please stay and take your time
findings.explanation: A natural invitation becomes conspicuously Japanese-shaped English.

findings.highlight: it’d help me out if you would coach me
findings.evidenceJa: 久しぶりに指導してもらえると助かります
findings.governingReading: it would help if he coached her for the first time in a while
findings.explanation: The history and renewed nature of Shirou coaching Sakura disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber, who is watching us quietly
findings.evidenceJa: 静かに見学しているセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber, who is quietly observing from beside the wall
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “us,” narrowing Saber’s general observation of the archery activity to watching Shirou and Sakura.

findings.highlight: So I should
findings.evidenceJa: それじゃあ
findings.governingReading: in that case—
findings.explanation: An unfinished transition is turned into the beginning of a specific first-person decision absent from the source.
